## Summary

What does this change do, and why?

## Runtime behavior

What runtime behavior changed? If none changed, say so explicitly.

## Evidence

What captured evidence supports the claims made by this change?

## Tests

What tests were added or updated? List the commands used to verify the change.

## Backwards compatibility

Describe compatibility implications and migration needs, or explain why there are none.

## Checklist

- [ ] I kept the change focused and composable.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for behavior changes.
- [ ] I updated documentation and the changelog where appropriate.
- [ ] I did not make claims that cannot be traced to evidence.
